T: Witness me. Then pass the water.
D: Max and Furiosa flee across the desert with a tyrant's escaped wives in a war rig.
P: Serve the drinks when Immortan Joe opens the water for the crowd below.
S: Crisp oat and seed crackers with sunflower, pumpkin, sesame, linseed and chia
Sunflower, pumpkin, sesame, linseed and chia seeds mixed with oats, water and salt, spread thin, baked at 160C for an hour until crisp, broken into shards.
the War Boys spray chrome before they ride

Popcorn tossed in brown butter, smoked salt and a little chilli, dusted with edible silver lustre so it shines like a War Boy's grin. Pop 150g popping corn in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot. Melt 60g butter and cook until nut brown. Toss the popcorn with the brown butter, 1 tsp smoked salt and a pinch of chilli flakes. Spread on a tray, cool for 5 minutes and dust lightly with 1 tsp edible silver lustre, tossing to coat.
Chicken thigh strips with smoked paprika and cumin, grilled until blackened
Chicken thigh strips threaded on skewers, rubbed with smoked paprika, cumin and chilli, grilled hot and blackened at the edges, with a garlic yoghurt dip.
M: Slow roast harissa lamb shoulder pulled apart, hummus, charred peppers, flatbread
Lamb shoulder rubbed with harissa, garlic and cumin, roasted at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart, with blistered flatbreads, hummus and charred capsicum.
Gas Town smoky beef and black bean stew
the long drive in the war rig

Beef chuck braised dark and thick with smoked paprika, chipotle, tomato and black beans, with charred damper and lime sour cream. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 chopped chipotle in adobo, 400g crushed tomatoes and 500ml beef stock. Return the beef, cover and braise at 160C for 2.5 hours, then add 2 drained tins black beans and cook 30 minutes more. Mix 400g self-raising flour with 250ml milk and salt, shape and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Mix sour cream with lime.
W: Date, oat and almond bars topped with dark chocolate and sea salt
Medjool dates, oats, almonds and honey blitzed, pressed into a tray, topped with melted dark chocolate and sea salt, set and cut into bars.
K: Cucumber, lime and mint muddled with sugar, topped up and served over ice

Cold sparkling water poured over cucumber, lime and mint muddled with a little sugar, in big jugs that flow freely, unlike the Citadel's. In two big jugs muddle a sliced Lebanese cucumber, 3 sliced limes, a handful of mint and 3 tbsp caster sugar until fragrant. Fill with ice and top with 2L cold sparkling water. Stir and pour freely for everyone.

steps.text: Mix all the seeds, oats and salt with the water.
Rest for 30 minutes so the chia and linseeds thicken it.
Spread thin on a lined tray.
Bake at 160C for 1 hour, until crisp. Break into shards.

Grill hot until blackened at the edges.
Mix the yoghurt with the garlic and salt for a dip.

Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart.
Blitz the chickpeas with the tahini, a splash of water and salt into hummus.
Char the capsicums over a flame, peel and slice.
Blister the flatbreads in a hot pan and serve everything together.

s.note: Crisp oat and seed crackers with sunflower, pumpkin, sesame, linseed and chia
s.how: Mix 50g each sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds, 30g linseeds, 30g chia seeds and 100g oats with 250ml water and salt. Rest 30 minutes, spread thin on a lined tray and bake at 160C for an hour. Break into shards.

s.note: Chicken thigh strips with smoked paprika and cumin, grilled until blackened
s.how: Cut 600g chicken thighs into strips and rub with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin and chilli flakes. Thread onto skewers and grill hot until blackened at the edges. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with a crushed garlic clove to dip.

m.note: Slow roast harissa lamb shoulder pulled apart, hummus, charred peppers, flatbread
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 3 tbsp harissa, garlic and cumin. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Blitz a tin of chickpeas into hummus. Char 2 red capsicums. Serve with 6 blistered flatbreads.

w.note: Date, oat and almond bars topped with dark chocolate and sea salt
w.how: Blitz 250g medjool dates, 100g oats, 100g almonds and 2 tbsp honey until sticky. Press into a lined tray. Pour over 150g melted dark chocolate, sprinkle with sea salt and chill to set. Cut into bars.

d.note: Cucumber, lime and mint muddled with sugar, topped up and served over ice
d.how: In two big jugs muddle a sliced Lebanese cucumber, 3 sliced limes, a handful of mint and 3 tbsp caster sugar until fragrant. Fill with ice and top with 2L cold sparkling water. Stir and pour freely for everyone.
